more.def: Showy in a way that is meant to impress people.
examples: He drove an ostentatious gold car.
The ostentatious hat had huge feathers.

easy.def: A very big bird that runs fast but cannot fly.

more.def: The largest bird in the world, with long legs and a long neck, that cannot fly but runs very fast.
examples: An ostrich can run faster than a horse.
The ostrich laid a huge egg in the sand.
Ostriches live on the grassy plains of Africa.
